fields.System.Title: OUT-207 — Respect minimum remaining shelf life
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a customer with a shelf life requirement, I want stock allocated only if enough life
remains, so that I do not receive goods my own customers will refuse.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a customer requiring N days remaining, then batches with less than N days are
  • excluded from allocation for that customer.
  • - Given the requirement, then it can be set per customer and overridden per order.
  • - Given stock that satisfies FEFO but fails the shelf life rule, then the rule wins and
  • the next batch is considered.
  • - Given no batch satisfies the requirement, then the line is not allocated and the
  • reason is explicit — not just "no stock".
  • - Given the excluded stock, then it remains available to customers without the
  • requirement.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, inventory, masterdata |
| Tables | allocation, batch, partner |
| Risks | Silent non-allocation indistinguishable from no stock |
| Tests | unit · integration |
